purpose: Fix a scale-choice rule for data-derived thresholds so that neither the threshold nor the scale is hand-picked, and check the stall threshold and the evidence table on held-out records.
scale_rule: For a positive variable, run Otsu (256 bins) on the linear scale (winsorized at the 99th percentile) and on the log scale (floor 1e-4). Compute Otsu effectiveness eta = between-class variance / total variance on each scale. Use the scale with the larger eta.

dev_data.theta: USB candidate distances, theta_ms_20261116 USB records (wait_cl BAL, all candidates, rows with history)
dev_data.stall: stall ratio r on unify0_20261116 NORULE (as stall_otsu_20261117)

holdout_data: qdata_20261116 eval arms Q200_OLD, Q400_OLD, Q200_NV, Q400_NV, QFULL_NV (no belief rule, different selectors, seed 20260921, 200 scenes each = 1000 episodes); residual estimator recomputed from obs_features (corr_est link_es_20261112, px<0.5, pr<2.9) as in run5.py; r = 24-step displacement / commanded displacement from action_policy
holdout_tables: belief tables k = 1..4 before the first switch (dist of chosen > 1.0), flip share, with (i) the dev stall threshold from the chosen scale and (ii) the threshold re-derived on the holdout by the same rule

predictions.P2: rule picks log for the stall ratio
predictions.P3: holdout re-derived stall threshold within a factor 1.5 of the dev one
predictions.P4: holdout evidence flip share at k = 2 >= 0.90 with the dev threshold
predictions.P5: holdout stall-only flip share at k = 2 < 0.85
predictions.P6: k = 2 chosen at q = 0.95 on the holdout (dev threshold)

decision: If P2, P4 and P6 hold, the stall definition (ratio, rule-chosen scale, Otsu threshold) goes into the server for the evidence-release simulation, which is preregistered separately and needs user approval. If P1 fails, the theta procedure must be revisited under the same rule.
